identity.title: Make process-backend output-limit and timeout precedence deterministic

values.task_boundary: Correct only process-backend output-limit versus timeout precedence and coupled cleanup proof.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Oversized file output observably present at deadline arbitration reports output_limit independent of scheduler order.
AC-2: Ordinary hanging execution reports timeout.
AC-3: Output-limit and timeout terminal paths leave no output artifacts and terminate owned process trees.
AC-4: Existing timeout, output-limit, cancellation, process-tree, and cleanup semantics remain green.
AC-5: Repeated focused pressure, required Runtime lane, strict Clippy, Observatory proof, and fresh exact-head review pass.
